data.other_hard: enrolment at a higher education institution in Baden-Württemberg or a partner institution abroad; exchange semesters of 1 or 2 semesters at a partner institution
data.evidence_sentence: The programme is intended for highly qualified undergraduates, graduates and doctoral candidates from all disciplines at institutions of higher education in Baden-Württemberg and their partner institutions abroad.
data.notes: Exchange-based mobility programme; funding period 3 to 11 months; amount 800 to 1,400 EUR per month depending on location and progress; applications handled by International Offices of home institutions, deadline varies and is not stated; nationality is not restricted but half of scholarships go to Baden-Württemberg students going abroad and half to candidates coming to Baden-Württemberg; page lists no explicit nationality rule; host country is Germany for incoming students but abroad for outgoing ones.
